title: 连接 Dify
description: 填写你的 Dify 地址和个人访问令牌。凭证仅保存在本机的 WorkBuddy 中。
description_en: Enter your Dify host and a personal access token. They are stored only on this computer, in WorkBuddy.

fields.label: Dify 地址
fields.description: 只填域名，不要带 https://、端口或路径。服务器需要能通过 HTTPS 的默认 443 端口访问。Dify 管理员需要开启 Open API。
fields.description_en: The host name only, without https://, a port or a path. The server must be reachable over HTTPS on port 443. Your Dify admin must turn on the Open API.

fields.label: 个人访问令牌
fields.description: 建议使用个人访问令牌。令牌的应用访问范围决定智能体能查找和运行哪些应用；管理插件、模型供应商或工具凭据需要令牌有工作区访问权限。工作区访问令牌只能查找和运行应用，不能管理插件、模型供应商和工具凭据，也不能填写暂停运行中的人工介入表单。
fields.description_en: A personal access token is recommended. Its app access decides which apps the agent can find and run; it needs workspace access to manage plugins, model providers or tool credentials. A workspace access token can only find and run apps: it cannot manage plugins, model providers or tool credentials, or fill in the human-input form of a paused run.
